śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || candanāgarukarpūratta mālajala kuṃkumam || kuśītaṃ kuṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || 1 || candanāgarukarpūra tatmālajala kuṃkumam || kuṣṭaṃ rakta candatam || 2 || candanāgaru hnīvera kuṣṭaṃ kuṃkuma sevyaka || jaṭāmāṃsī surabhirtiviṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam || 3 || candanā guruvālā kuḍakuṃkumaśvetavirāya mūla jaṭāmāṃsīdevadāru iti viṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtaṃ || svarūpa candane cora rocanāguru meva ca || 4 || madaṃ mṛgachayo bhūtaṃ kastracandra saṃyutam || gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśasya maheśituḥ || 5 || candanāguru karpūra corakuṃkuma rocanā || jaṭāmāṃsī kapiyutā śaktyai gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ || 6 || corakākittavaṃ ścorāḍo'puka sevitoripuḥ || silūkaḥ kapijodhūmraḥ turuṣkaḥ piṇḍikaviḥ || 7 || silājit || dīpaṃ dakṣiṇatodadyā puratovāta pṛṣṭhataḥ || vāmatastu tathā dhūpamagrevāna tu dikṣiṇe || 8 || naivedyaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme puratovani pṛṣṭhataḥ || devatāyāḥ || nivaraṃ dakṣṇekarṇe vāmecaivaṃ tathādyacchat || 9 || dvijātī nāmeṣavidhi strī śrūdrāṇāṃ ca vāmake || mantradani || tvat prasādādahaṃ devakṛttakṛtyosmi sarvataḥ || māyāmṛtyu mahāpāśādvitirmuktosmi śivosmiti || 1 || iti śiṣyo vadet || uttiṣṭovat samuktosisamyagācāravān bhavaḥ || hrīti śrīkāntiputrāyurvalā rogyaṃ sadā stute || 2 || iti gururvadet || [iti mahākāla saṃhitāyāṃ maṃtradāna vidhiḥ] || svasti śrīsaṃvat (1952) sālamitijyaiṣṭavadi (14) roja (5)māli ṣitaṃ midaṃ pustakaṃ dharmarāja tṛpāṭhī dvijena || svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca ||
